extracted.name: Cream sauce broccoli
extracted.description: #GoldenApron23 Week 2: broccoli My English is not good enough so maybe sometimes I’ll have some wrong words!
instruction_lines: Boil a pot of water to blanch the broccoli
While waiting, cut onion and garlic into small pieces
Blanch the broccoli around 2 minutes. At the same time preheat the oven to 400 degrees
Use medium low heat all the time for cream sauce! First, put the onion and garlic frying until the onion turns translucent
Put the butter first until it melts and then put the all-purpose flour stirring until the powder disappear
Add milk into the pan and stir until it starts turning thick
Add the cheese and the seasoning
Put the broccoli into pan and mix them well and then put them in a container which can go into the oven
Tell the broccoli see you 20 minutes later and swing your hand
